pages.text: Live refinement runs on the $(item)Song Bench$(), not the Echo shrine blocks. Seat raw ore, cobble, iron-like metal, or March grit, then start the song.

$(bold)Shatter$() (Earth) → Echo Shard$(br)$(bold)Attune$() (Fire) → Attuned Echo$(br)$(bold)Bind$() (Water) → Bound Echo$(br)$(bold)Manifest$() (Spirit) → Manifested Ingot$(br)$(br)Each stage drinks Spirit Pulse from nearby Drumhearts, Ley Collectors, then Totems, and needs the matching Resonance Totem within song range.

Echo Shatter / Attune / Bind / Manifest blocks are camp markers only. They do not process ores. Shift-click the Song Bench to remove grit; wrong attunement or empty Pulse stalls the song without destroying the item.
